title: Oven Roasted Mexican Kabocha Tacos Al Pastor
description: A vegan friendly Mexican dish featuring roasted kabocha squash, served in pandan leaf wraps with a blend of spices and flavors, perfect for a midnight craving. This dish is inspired by the traditional Veracruzan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the kabocha squash with olive oil, cumin, paprika, and salt until evenly coated.
Spread the squash on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, or until tender.
While the squash is roasting, heat the chipotle peppers and adobo sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the pan and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Once the squash is done, add it to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Warm the pandan leaves by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the squash mixture onto a pandan leaf and squeezing with lime juice.
